Official Address

Welcome Message from the Head of Department

"Welcome to the Department of Computer Science at the University of Loralai. In today's world, technology is not just a tool; it is the driving force behind progress. Here in Loralai, we are committed to empowering our students to become a part of this global change. Our mission is simple: to provide a strong foundation in the fundamentals of computing in a supportive and practical learning environment. We focus on building your skills from the ground up—clear thinking, problem-solving, and hands-on experience with modern technologies. Our dedicated faculty is here to guide you, not just in your studies, but in shaping a successful career. To our students, I say: Your journey here is about more than earning a degree. It is about building the confidence and ability to create solutions, to innovate, and to lead in the digital age. Whether you dream of developing software, securing networks, or launching your own tech venture, this department is your starting point. We encourage you to learn with curiosity, work with passion, and aim to make a positive impact through technology. The future is digital, and together, we will prepare you to build it. Mr. M. Khawar Abbas Chairperson, Department of Computer Science University of Loralai"

M. Khawar Abbas

Chairperson Department of Computer Science
